label: Wrath of the Heavens
author: Created by: Chad Bradly and Edited by NAUR Staff Team

steps.label: Setup
steps.note: MT starts south and party is north the boss will do cleaving autos at the start here.

steps.label: Wrath of the Heavens
steps.note: When Wrath of the Heavens casts start middle so you can move to your spot quicker.

steps.label: Adds Spawn in
steps.note:
Two Dragoons, A white twister dragon and two thicc dragons will spawn.

Twister dragon will be relative north for this mechanic.

steps.label: Position
steps.note:
The party will spread to the right of the dragoons.

Tethered players go opposite of their dragoon. 4 notches from the intercard!!

Blue marked player four notches from NW (if dives are new north).

steps.label: Twister
steps.note:
Once orange tethers disappear move for twister.

A green circle divebomb marker will also appear at this time.

*NOTE*
For any ucob players the twister dose not snapshot when the cast bar for Twisting Dive is done but it instead snapshots when the animation plays.

steps.label: Cleaves
steps.note:
Spread around Thordan so that the cleaves don't overlap.
NOTE the two tethered players rotate west. This isolates them from liquid hell.

The player with the divebomb marker goes to the wall on the opposite side of the arena from the warrior, or behind the mage.

steps.label: Random Baits
steps.note:
Get ready for 5 Liquid Heaven baits on a random person and 4 Eruption baits on another random person.

If the warrior spawns near you make sure to move away from him so that you don't drop a circle aoe near him.

MAKE SURE that you don't drop any of these near the war but also don't end your baits too far away to make it inside the doughnut aoe.

steps.label: Random Baits #2
steps.note:
Thunder players go opposite Thordan. 

Everyone else stacks close to Thordan.

steps.label: Random Baits #3
steps.note: Keep baiting and make sure to bait puddles in a way that won't block off movement for anyone trying to get to the stack.

steps.label: Everything resolves.
steps.note: Divebombs, Circle aoe and thunder resolve.
